DynamicValue.description:
A persisted dynamic value is always a tagged object.  It deliberately
lives beside ordinary JSON rather than overloading strings, so business
payloads cannot accidentally become expressions.

cardinalities.description: Frozen per-port item cardinality from the published Node Manifest.

portSchemas.description: Frozen per-port JSON Schemas after applying node-instance projections.

ExecutionOriginV1.description:
Immutable audit context captured when an Execution is created.

Control remains authoritative for current IAM and resource names. Runtime
stores this snapshot so later renames do not rewrite execution history.
